title: Biomedical Equipment Defect and Breakdown
content:
SOP: Biomedical Equipment Defect and Breakdown (SOP-BIO-001)
DEPARTMENT: Biomedical Engineering
VERSION: 1.9
ROLES: nurse, biomedical_engineer
PURPOSE: Rapid response within 15 minutes for critical life support equipment.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Biomedical Equipment Defect and Breakdown in full compliance with Biomedical Engineering hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Biomedical Equipment Defect and Breakdown in full compliance with Biomedical Engineering hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Biomedical Equipment Defect and Breakdown in full compliance with Biomedical Engineering hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Biomedical Equipment Defect and Breakdown in full compliance with Biomedical Engineering hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Biomedical Equipment Defect and Breakdown in full compliance with Biomedical Engineering hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Biomedical Engineering.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-BIO-001 Biomedical Equipment Defect and Breakdown v1.9, Section 4
